minutes.headline: Planning Board re-endorsed the corrected Bright Farms ANR plan and workshopped parking and subdivision rules.
minutes.summary: The board approved two sets of minutes, re-endorsed a revised ANR plan for Bright Farms after a surveyor's distance error, and heard committee reports. It workshopped a draft parking and loading bylaw (restaurant ratios, employees, takeout, combining sections 6.1 and 6.4) and began reviewing the draft subdivision regulations. Director's items covered a cannabis community meeting on February 4.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted, by roll call, to approve a revised ANR plan for Bright Farms after a surveyor's distance error was corrected.
Members were asked to sign the endorsed Bright Farms plan at the office by Thursday so the applicant can close.
The board continued a workshop on a draft parking and loading bylaw; the land use director will draft a parking table matching the use table and combine sections 6.1 and 6.4.
Review of the draft subdivision regulations began and will return on a future agenda once members have read the draft.
Committee reports covered a capital planning priority list, a possible higher capital request threshold, and a regional planning retirement funding liability.

why_it_matters: The parking and subdivision rewrites would change what new businesses and housing developments must provide, and they are likely to reach Town Meeting as bylaw votes.
The capital planning list and threshold change affect which town projects are recommended for funding, which can reach the tax bill.
watch_next: Planning Board meetings set for January 25 and about February 8, remote until further notice.
A future agenda item on the draft subdivision regulations, and a revised parking table from the land use director.
